title: finding(plugin-timeline): `ObjectTimeline` never clears `error` — one failed load keeps the error screen up after later loads succeed, and once objectui#10623 lands every data-invalidation re-read is a new way in (the objectui#10578 shape)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites (class a). A transient failure becomes a permanent error screen. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the contract review of PR objectui#10649 (objectui#10623) at `008a5df`. The review read it at source. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Sites (read by the seat on objectui `origin/main`)

`packages/plugin-timeline/src/ObjectTimeline.tsx`:
- `const [error, setError] = useState` (~:258);
- `setError(e as Error)` in the fetch's `catch` (~:414), the only write, with no `setError(null)` anywhere;
- `if (error) {` (~:808) returns the error screen above the canvas.

## Reach

On `main` a failure can start only from mount, a query change, or pull-to-refresh. After it, every later successful fetch updates the rows while the error screen stays until remount. PR objectui#10649 (objectui#10623, in rework) makes `object-timeline` re-read on every data-invalidation event, and the console bridges every data-source write onto that bus. Once it lands, one failed background re-read puts a healthy timeline on a permanent error screen. The mechanism is pre-existing; the reach grows with objectui#10623. PR objectui#10649 is fixing the same defect for `object-map` in its own surface, following `ObjectGantt`.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Take the objectui#10578 shape (`ObjectGantt`): clear `error` on a successful commit. Decide whether a failed background re-read keeps the last good rows, as `ObjectGantt`'s silent mode does. Pin both: a failure, then a success, shows the rows; and a re-read failure over good rows.

## Dedupe

REST read of every objectui issue and PR updated since 2026-09-24T00:00Z (740 items), titles matched against `timeline.*error|error.*timeline|clears`: the only hit is objectui#10578 (`ObjectGantt`, closed, fixed by PR objectui#10630). Lit control: that same walk finds objectui#10578.
